title: Finite principal-open cover carrying pseudo-coherent localized module models
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $M^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules. Write $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme] and $E=\widetilde{M^\bullet}$ in its derived category [def-pc-derived-category]. If $E$ is pseudo-coherent [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], there exist $r\geq0$ and $f:\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\to A$ with $(f_0,\ldots,f_{r-1})=A$ such that, for every $i$, the scalar-extended complex $A_{f_i}\otimes_A M^\bullet$ is pseudo-coherent in the module derived category [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex], that is, it is isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free $A_{f_i}$-modules. Derived categories may be chosen independently for $A$, for sheaves on $X$ and its opens, and for the localization rings.

source.place: Tag 08E7 (perfect-lemma-pseudo-coherent-affine), finite standard-open cover and identification of localized module models; local finite-free characterization in Tags 08CB and 08E5

proof.text: Let $S$ be the set of $f\in A$ for which $Q(A_f\otimes_A M)$ is pseudo-coherent. At each prime $x$, unfold scheme pseudo-coherence to obtain $U$, a bounded-above finite-free complex $P$ on $U$, and a derived isomorphism with the restricted input. Use Mathlib PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.isOpen_iff to choose $D(f)\subseteq U$ containing $x$. Apply the single-open model comparison to conclude $f\in S$.

The principal opens defined by $S$ cover the spectrum. Apply PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff' to obtain $\operatorname{span}(S)=A$. Apply Mathlib Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_finite to extract a finite subset $t\subseteq S$ with $\operatorname{span}(t)=A$; this is finite generation of the membership of 1 and needs no separate topological compactness argument.

Enumerate $t$ using the inverse of Fintype.equivFin t. Its range is exactly $t$, so the span condition is unchanged. Each value belongs to $S$ by $t\subseteq S$, giving every requested localized pseudo-coherence assertion. The same argument applies when the spectrum is empty and $t$ has cardinality zero.

lean.statement: theorem affine_pseudoCoherent_localization_cover (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))] [∀ f : A, HasDerivedCategory.{wL} (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f))] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (h : Scheme.IsPseudoCoherent (Spec (.of A)) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A) (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A)) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))) : ∃ (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A), Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ i : Fin r, DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f i)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))
